content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Springfield

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific hour and credential thresholds for your background. Granite PM Academy's advisors can verify your qualifications before you enroll, ensuring you meet all prerequisites to sit for the exam.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® Certification Training course. Attend sessions from your Springfield location on a schedule that fits your work and personal commitments. All instruction is delivered online; you'll engage with active certified practitioners and cohort peers in real time.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, create your PMI account and complete the PMP® credential application. Upload documentation of your education and project experience. Pay the PMI application and exam fee through the PMI portal to finalize your registration and secure your exam seat.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP® Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—study guides, practice questions, and instructor support—to build confidence. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE test center in Springfield or nearby. Take the four-hour, 180-question exam and work toward earning your PMP® credential.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: Once certified, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Pursue PDUs through training, volunteer work, or professional contributions in your local job market or industry. Renew your credential before expiration by submitting your PDU record to PMI.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI requires either a four-year degree with 36 months of project leadership experience, or a high school diploma with 60 months of experience. All applicants need 35 contact hours of PM education — our course satisfies this requirement.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.
